rubric_items.contrast: Text clears its background without ambiguity: the panel labels and legend text render near-black on white. The data marks were measured on the rendered PNGs: darkest contour stroke pixels 3.84:1 (diverted) and 4.37:1 (limited) against white, red null markers 5.89:1, purple map-image markers 6.81:1, all at or above the 3:1 line the plotting rules hold for coloured series.
rubric_items.data_ink: The data carry the visual weight in both figures. Every mark is a contour line, the first wall, or a null marker; there is no fill, colour map, shading or panel furniture, and the pair shares one level array so the two panels are directly comparable.
rubric_items.decoration: Neither figure carries a gradient, background fill, grid, frame, tick or styled theme. The face is white, the panels are drawn with the axis off, and the only non-data ink is the two-entry legend and one short direct label per panel.
rubric_items.label_collision: No label is clipped, overlapping another label, or lying over data. Each direct label sits above the upper-left of its panel in clear space (nearest contour 5 px or more away) and the legend sits above the panels. Measured on the rendered PNGs, no ink falls within 4 px of any canvas edge in either figure, so nothing is cut off at the boundary.
rubric_items.legibility: Both rendered PNGs read at a glance. Each is two identically framed poloidal panels, left 'map image' and right 'analytic state', carrying unfilled blue line contours and a black first wall, with a frameless two-entry legend across the top ('analytic nulls' red, 'map-image nulls' purple). The limited case (image-1) draws one red axis triangle per panel with the purple map-image triangle visible as a fringe beneath, over 13 to 14 concentric contours. The diverted case (image-0) draws the axis triangle high in each panel and the admitted saddle as a red filled cross with the larger purple cross beneath it at the divertor, with the separatrix legs and the private-flux loop below the X-point individually readable. Contour crossings along a mid-plane row agree across the pair (13 to 14 closed contours per panel), consistent with the shared level array.
rubric_items.table_form: Neither image depicts tabular information. Both are poloidal flux maps whose contour compression, X-point topology and vessel boundary are spatial relationships; the rung table these panels accompany lives in the evidence fragment as an HTML table.
